findings.title: Unsafe archive extraction can escape the output directory
findings.summary: An attacker-controlled path reaches a filesystem write without containment validation.

confidence.rationale: Direct source trace reaches the filesystem write without a containment check.

findings.remediation: Normalize destinations and reject entries that escape the extraction root.

validation.summary: An archive entry can select a path outside the extraction root.
evidence: The untrusted entry name reaches the filesystem write without normalization or a containment check.
limitations: The extraction route was not exercised dynamically.

attackPath.dataflow: archive entry name -> joined destination path -> filesystem write outside the extraction root

remediationTests: Assert that extracting an archive entry named `../escape.txt` fails without writing outside the extraction root.
preventiveControls: Route all archive extraction through one helper that normalizes and validates destination paths.

codeEvidence.label: Unchecked archive write
codeEvidence.code:
destination = output_dir / entry.name
with archive.open(entry) as source:
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_bytes(source.read())
codeEvidence.explanation: The destination incorporates an untrusted archive entry name and is written without a containment check.

rootCause.summary: The extractor joins the entry name to the output directory without checking whether the destination stays inside it.
